ml-pca-variance-07: $C$ diagonal hai, to PCs seedhe axes hain. Par PC1 wo axis hai jiska variance sabse bada hai — jo pehle likha hai wo nahi.
Explained ratio $= \lambda_1 / \operatorname{trace}(C)$. Yahan eigenvalues diagonal entries 7, 2, 11 hi hain.
Sabse bada $\lambda$ chuno aur trace $7 + 2 + 11 = 20$ nikalo. Trap: fraction lost $1 - \text{ratio}$ de dena, ya ratio ki jagah variance likh dena.
ml-pca-variance-08: Do cheezein match karni hain: PC2 ka direction aur uska variance. Off-diagonal 4 hai, to PCs axes nahi honge.
Eigenvalues: $\lambda = 5 \pm \sqrt{25 - 9}$. PC2 = chhote eigenvalue ka eigenvector.
$C(1,1)^\top = (9, 9)^\top$ check karo; ab $C(1,-1)^\top$ khud nikalo. Trap: sahi direction ke saath bada eigenvalue jod dena.
ml-pca-variance-09: Raw points diye hain aur divisor $n - 1$ fixed hai. Pehle center, phir covariance, phir bada eigenvalue.
Mean nikalo, $C = \frac{1}{4}\sum_i \tilde x_i \tilde x_i^\top$. 2×2 ke liye $\lambda = T/2 \pm \sqrt{T^2/4 - D}$.
Mean $= (3, 3)$; centered points $(-2,-1), (-1,-2), (0,1), (1,0), (2,2)$. Ab $\sum \tilde x_1^2$, $\sum \tilde x_2^2$, $\sum \tilde x_1 \tilde x_2$ nikalo. Trap: divisor 5 lena.
ml-pca-variance-10: Kisi diye hue direction par variance poocha hai, PC1 par nahi. Aur $(3, 4)$ unit vector nahi hai.
Unit $u$ ke liye variance $= u^\top C u = 4u_1^2 + 2\cdot 1\cdot u_1 u_2 + 2u_2^2$.
$\lVert(3,4)\rVert = 5$, to $u = (0.6, 0.8)$. Ab teen terms plug karo. Trap: cross term ka factor 2 bhool jaana, ya normalise na karna.
ml-pca-variance-11: MSQ — har statement ko eigenvalues 6, 3, 1 se alag check karo: total, retained ratio, reconstruction error, aur PC2 ka variance.
Total $= \sum \lambda$. Retained ratio $= \sum_{\text{kept}} \lambda / \sum \lambda$. Reconstruction MSE $= \sum_{\text{dropped}} \lambda$. Variance along PC $k = \lambda_k$.
Sirf PC1 rakhne par dropped eigenvalues 3 aur 1 hain — inka sum kitna? Trap: kept variance ko error samajh lena, ya ratio ko variance.
ml-pca-variance-12: Off-diagonal 2 features 2 aur 3 ke beech hai, to diagonal entries eigenvalues nahi hain. $C$ block-diagonal hai.
Eigenvalues: feature 1 se 2, aur block $\begin{pmatrix} 5 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ ke do eigenvalues ($T = 7$, $D = 6$). Total $= 9$.
Block ke eigenvalues nikalo, sab ko descending sort karo, phir cumulative ratio 0.85 se compare karo. Trap: diagonal 5, 2, 2 se count karna.
ml-pca-variance-13: Top 2 rakhe, baaki 2 drop hue. Poocha hai fraction **lost**, retained nahi.
Fraction lost $= (\text{dropped eigenvalues ka sum}) / (\text{sab eigenvalues ka sum})$.
Total $= 9 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 16$. Dropped kaun se hain? Trap: sirf aakhri eigenvalue drop maanna, ya ratio ki jagah MSE likhna.
ml-pca-variance-14: Sirf feature 1 scale hua hai, to poora $C$ ek number se multiply nahi hota. Naya $C$ banana padega.
Naya $C = \begin{pmatrix} 16 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$, $T = 17$, $D = 12$. Ab root nikalo. Trap: purane $\lambda_{\max}$ ko 2 ya 4 se multiply karna.
ml-pca-variance-15: MSQ — pehle eigenvalues nikalo; phir har statement ko unit-direction variance ki range se judge karo.
$T = 9$, $D = 14$, $\lambda = 4.5 \pm \sqrt{20.25 - 14}$. Unit $u$ ke liye $\lambda_{\min} \le u^\top C u \le \lambda_{\max}$; axis $e_1$ par variance $= C_{11}$.
Eigenvalues ke baad: 1.5 range ke andar hai ya bahar? PC1 ka ratio diagonal se nahi, $\lambda_{\max}/9$ se. Trap: diagonal 6 ko PC1 variance maanna.
ml-pca-variance-16: $C$ block-diagonal hai: features 1–2 ek block, feature 3 alag. Off-diagonal 2 ki wajah se diagonal entries eigenvalues nahi.
Block $\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$: $T = 4$, $D = 0$. Feature 3 ka eigenvalue 3. Sab sort karke doosra lo.
Block ke eigenvalues $\lambda^2 - 4\lambda = 0$ se aate hain. Inhe 3 ke saath descending order me rakho. Trap: diagonal 3, 2, 2 sort karke doosra lena.
ml-pca-lda-07: LDA directions par do limit lagti hain: classes ki aur features ki. Yahan features (4) classes (6) se kam hain.
Max directions $= \min(C - 1, d)$: between-class scatter ka rank $\le C - 1$, aur $d$-dim space me $d$ se zyada independent directions nahi.
$C - 1 = 6 - 1$ aur $d = 4$ — dono compare karo. Trap: sirf $C - 1$ likh dena aur feature limit bhool jaana.
ml-pca-lda-08: Singular values diye hain, eigenvalues nahi. Total variance $= $ sab eigenvalues ka sum.
Squares: $8^2 = 64$, $4^2 = 16$, $2^2 = 4$. Ab jodo aur $n$ se divide karo. Trap: $\sigma$ ko square kiye bina divide karna.
ml-pca-lda-09: Principal directions feature space ke vectors hain — har vector me ek entry per feature. Dekho SVD ke kis factor ka size feature-wise hai.
$X^\top X = V\Sigma U^\top U \Sigma V^\top$. $U^\top U = I$ use karo.
Simplify karke $X^\top X = V\Sigma^2 V^\top$ — ye eigen-decomposition hai. Ab socho eigenvectors kahan hain. Trap: $U$ aur $V$ swap karna.
ml-pca-lda-10: MSQ — har statement ke liye socho: centering se mean, covariance aur uncentered matrix $\frac1n X^\top X$ par kya asar hota hai.
$\frac1n X^\top X = C + \bar x\bar x^\top$. Sab points ko ek hi vector se shift karne par covariance $C$ same rehta hai.
Units wala statement: centering (mean ghatana) aur standardizing (SD se divide) alag steps hain — kaun sa units ki wajah se hai? Trap: dono ko ek samajhna.
ml-pca-lda-11: Formula $J(u)$ stem me diya hai. Bas $u = e_1$ aur $u = e_2$ ke liye numerator aur denominator dono nikalne hain.
$J(e_1) = (\text{mean gap along } x_1)^2 / S_{W,11}$, $J(e_2) = (\text{mean gap along } x_2)^2 / S_{W,22}$.
$J(e_1) = 4^2 / 8$. Ab $J(e_2)$ nikalo aur compare karo. Trap: sirf mean gap dekhna aur within-class spread ignore karna.
ml-pca-lda-12: Labels hain aur goal hai classes ko **separate** karna — sirf variance rakhna nahi. Ye supervised projection ka kaam hai.
PCA: max variance, labels ignore. LDA: max $\frac{\text{between-class}}{\text{within-class}}$ scatter, at most $C - 1$ directions. k-means: clustering, projection nahi.
Yahan $C = 2$, to supervised method kitni directions de sakta hai? Kya utni chahiye? Trap: PC1 ko class-separating maan lena.
ml-pca-lda-13: $M$ uncentered hai. Sahi PCA ke liye pehle centered covariance banana hai — $M$ ka eigenvalue seedha mat lo.
$C = M - \bar x\bar x^\top$, aur $\bar x\bar x^\top = \begin{pmatrix} 4 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$. Phir $\lambda_{\max} = T/2 + \sqrt{T^2/4 - D}$.
$C = \begin{pmatrix} 6 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$, $T = 10$, $D = 8$. Ab root nikalo. Trap: $M$ ka hi bada eigenvalue de dena.
ml-pca-lda-14: MSQ — har statement ko PCA/LDA ke basic facts se check karo: labels chahiye?, kitni directions?, projection linear?, Fisher ratio me kya hai?
PCA: covariance ke eigenvectors, labels nahi. LDA: $J = \frac{\text{between-class}}{\text{within-class}}$, at most $C - 1$ directions. Dono $x \mapsto w^\top x$.
Fisher ratio ka numerator class means se banta hai ya nahi? Aur $C - 1$ wali limit todi ja sakti hai? Trap: LDA ko sirf within-class spread se jodna.
ml-pca-lda-15: Ulta direction: variance diya hai, singular value poochi hai. Link formula ulta chalana hai.
$\sigma_1^2 = 8 \times 4.5$ nikalo; phir ek step aur baaki hai. Trap: $\sigma_1^2$ par ruk jaana, ya $n$ se divide kar dena.
ml-pca-lda-16: Standardize karne ke baad covariance matrix correlation matrix ban jaati hai — diagonal 1, off-diagonal $= r$.
$r = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}}{\sigma_1 \sigma_2} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{100}\sqrt{1}}$. Matrix $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & r \\ r & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ ke eigenvalues $1 \pm r$.
Pehle $r$ nikalo, phir bada eigenvalue $1 + r$ ko trace 2 se divide karo. Trap: raw covariance pe hi PCA karna.
ml-select-framing-07: Target dekho: listing ki category. Codes 1–12 sirf naam hain ya sach me quantity?
Rule: real-valued quantity → regression; finite set ka label (numbers me likha ho tab bhi) → classification; label hi nahi → unsupervised.
'4.6 test' lagao: category 6.5 ka kuch matlab hai? Aur past listings ki category pata hai ya nahi? Trap: codes dekh ke regression bol dena.
ml-select-framing-08: Target ek amount hai — rupaye me bill. Socho ye label hai ya quantity.
Real-valued target + past labelled data → supervised regression. Rounding se quantity label nahi banti.
'4.6 test': ₹1,234.6 ka bill meaningful hai? Agar haan, to target quantity hai. Trap: whole rupees dekh ke classification bolna.
ml-select-framing-09: MSQ — har task me dekho: training data me target/label hai ya sirf $x$?
Unsupervised = koi target nahi (clustering, PCA). Labels (left/stayed, fraud/not fraud) ho to supervised classification.
News articles aur gene data me koi label diya hai? Churn aur fraud wale records me kya mark kiya hai? Trap: 'fraud detection' sun ke anomaly/unsupervised bolna.
ml-select-framing-10: Paanch tasks hain; har ek ka target dekho — quantity hai ya finite set ka label?
'4.6 test': agar beech ki value (jaise 40.5) ka matlab bane to regression; warna classification. Numbers me likha label phir bhi label hai.
(i) blood pressure 120.5 mmHg meaningful hai; (ii) blood group finite set hai. Ab (iii)–(v) khud check karo. Trap: PIN code ko number samajhna.
ml-select-framing-11: Digit 0–9 image ki **class** hai. Squared loss us code ko quantity maan ke chalta hai — kya ye sahi hai?
Squared loss me 1 aur 2 ki galti $1^2$, 1 aur 7 ki galti $6^2$. Images ke liye ye order/distance real hai?
'4.6 test' lagao: output 4.6 ka kya matlab? Phir socho target kis type ka hai. Trap: digits numbers hain to regression theek maan lena.
ml-select-framing-12: Images unlabelled hain, aur goal 4,096 numbers ko 50 me compress karna hai, variation bacha ke. Koi target predict nahi karna.
Target nahi → unsupervised. Max variance rakhte hue kam dimensions → dimensionality reduction. LDA ko labels chahiye.
Har option ke liye poochho: kya isko labels chahiye? Images ke paas labels hain? Trap: pixel values numeric hain to regression bolna.
ml-select-framing-13: MSQ — har task me dekho: target do values wala label hai, quantity hai, ya target hi nahi?
Binary classification = training data me 2-valued label. Probability output wala yes/no event bhi classification hai. k-means me labels nahi hote.
Bought = 1/0 wale task me training target kya hai — probability ya yes/no? Trap: '2 segments' ko binary classification maan lena.
ml-select-framing-14: Output whole number hai, par sawal ye hai: arrivals ki count quantity hai ya label?
'4.6 test': average 87.4 arrivals meaningful hai to regression. Integer output akele classification nahi banata.
Socho 120 aur 121 'paas' hain ya alag classes? Aur kya past hourly counts (labels) diye hain? Trap: integer dekh ke classification bolna.
ml-select-framing-15: Supervised aur unsupervised ka farak training data ke ek hi ingredient se aata hai.
Supervised: pairs $(x_i, y_i)$. Unsupervised: sirf $x_i$ (k-means, PCA).
Har option ke liye poochho: kya k-means/PCA ko bhi ye chahiye? Agar haan, to wo farak nahi hai. Trap: distance measure ko farak samajhna.
ml-select-framing-16: Paanch tasks; har ek ka target dekho: quantity ya finite labels? Probability wale task me training label par dhyan do.
Real quantity → regression; finite set (3 candidates, S/M/L/XL, yes/no) → classification. Yes/no event ki probability = classification.
(i) rent quantity hai, (ii) 3 me se ek label hai. Ab (iii)–(v) khud decide karo. Trap: probability output ko regression maan lena.
ml-select-algo-07: Har model ke liye poochho: ye $P(x \mid y)$ model karta hai ya seedha $P(y \mid x)$? Naam pe mat jaao.
Generative: $P(x \mid y)P(y)$ + Bayes rule (Naive Bayes, LDA, QDA). Discriminative: $P(y \mid x)$ ya boundary seedha (logistic, SVM, perceptron).
LDA aur QDA dono har class ko Gaussian se model karte hain — to wo kis group me gaye? Trap: 'discriminant' naam dekh ke LDA chun lena.
ml-select-algo-08: Naive Bayes ka matlab: features class ke given independent. To har (class, feature) ke liye ek alag probability, plus priors.
Count $= (K - 1) + K \cdot d$, kyunki $K$ priors ka sum 1 hai aur binary feature ke liye ek hi number $P(x_j = 1 \mid y)$ kaafi hai.
Yahan $K = 3$, $d = 8$: feature part $3 \times 8 = 24$. Ab priors jodo. Trap: priors bhoolna, ya 3 independent priors ginna.
ml-select-algo-09: Variance dono classes ki same hai, par priors unequal (0.75 vs 0.25) — to boundary means ke midpoint se khiskegi.
Midpoint $= 4$, aur $\pi_0/\pi_1 = 3$. Ab shift term nikalo — wo kis taraf jaayega? Trap: priors ignore karna, ya $\sigma^2$ ki jagah $\sigma = 2$ lena.
ml-select-algo-10: Ek feature ×1000 hua. Socho har model ki prediction kis cheez par depend karti hai — threshold, per-class mean/SD, weight, ya raw distance?
Tree: threshold bhi ×1000. Gaussian NB: us feature ka mean aur SD dono ×1000. OLS: weight ÷1000. k-NN: Euclidean distance me raw values jaati hain.
k-NN me $(\Delta x_1)^2$ ab $10^6$ guna — kya neighbours wahi rahenge? Baaki models me scaling absorb hoti hai ya nahi, check karo. Trap: tree ko scale-sensitive maanna.
ml-select-algo-11: Naya $x$ banane (sample karne) ke liye model ke paas $P(x \mid y)$ hona chahiye. Har option me dekho ye hai ya nahi.
Generative models $P(x \mid y)P(y)$ store karte hain (Gaussian NB, LDA). Discriminative sirf $P(y \mid x)$; k-NN sirf data store karta hai.
LDA me har class $\mathcal N(\mu_k, \Sigma)$ hai — kya isse sample ho sakta hai? Logistic regression me $x$ ka koi model hai? Trap: LDA ko discriminative samajhna.
ml-select-algo-12: Boundary ek circle hai — raw $(x_1, x_2)$ me ye linear nahi hai. Extra features ($x_1^2 + x_2^2$) allowed nahi.
Logistic regression aur perceptron raw features par straight line dete hain. Shared-covariance Gaussians bhi linear boundary dete hain. Kernel methods nonlinear.
Har option ke liye poochho: raw features par iski boundary line hai ya curve? Trap: generative Gaussian ko automatically nonlinear maan lena.
ml-select-algo-13: Teen demands: labels se probability, linear boundary, aur har feature ka ek weight jo log-odds effect bataaye.
Logistic regression: $\log\frac{P(y=1 \mid x)}{P(y=0 \mid x)} = w^\top x + b$. k-means/PCA labels use nahi karte; k-NN me weights nahi.
Har option ko teeno demands pe tick karo — kaun sa ek bhi miss karta hai? Trap: k-NN ko probability deta dekh ke chun lena.
ml-select-algo-14: MSQ — chaar alag facts: Gaussian covariances aur boundary shape, logistic regression ke assumptions, k-NN ki training, aur tree ko scaling.
Same $\Sigma$ → $x^\top\Sigma^{-1}x$ cancel → linear; alag $\Sigma_k$ → quadratic. Logistic sirf linear log-odds maanta hai. Tree split: ek feature vs threshold.
Tree me feature ×10 karo to threshold bhi ×10 — prediction badlegi? Aur k-NN training me kya compute hota hai? Trap: logistic ko Gaussian assumption dena.
ml-select-algo-15: Same variance aur **equal** priors — to prior wala shift term zero ho jaata hai.
Ab sirf $\mu_0 = -1$ aur $\mu_1 = 5$ ka midpoint chahiye. Trap: $(\mu_1 - \mu_0)/2$ lena, ya 2 se divide karna bhoolna.
ml-select-algo-16: Generative vs discriminative ka trade-off data size aur assumptions se judta hai. Har option me dekho kaun sa side favour hota hai.
Naive Bayes: strong assumptions, kam parameters → kam data me jaldi seekhta hai. Logistic: kam assumptions → zyada data me aage nikalta hai.
Correlated features Naive Bayes ke kis assumption ko todte hain? Aur bina labels ke kya koi classifier train hoga? Trap: data-size wali baat ulta padhna.
